mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months indicates monetary easing, lowering discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past 3 months signals strengthening labor market conditions, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 1400 thousand units in the current month signals weakening consumer demand, reducing economic growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1400.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past month indicate dual sector contraction, reducing corporate profitability and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO and RSAFS both decline.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 300), a federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations to cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 300 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index, 2017=100) in the current month indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing economic growth forecasts and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% indicates monetary policy tightening cooling the housing sector, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST declines and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals unexpected labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue growth to cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5 and PAYEMS declines.
